name: 2C-P
addictionPotential: Low potential for abuse and dependence
summary: A synthetic phenylethlyamine that is sometimes compared in effects to 2C-E, yet with a much longer duration. With a much more pronouced bodyload. Is one of the most potent of the 2C-X series.
saferUse: PsychonautWiki strongly warns against redosing within 3 hours and advises first-time users to stay at or below the moderate category. It recommends accurate volumetric measurement, avoiding visual estimation and non-oral routes, and using harm-reduction measures. Its dose table is educational, not a recommendation.
metabolism: What is known about how the body handles this is very limited. No metabolic enzymes, metabolites or pathway have been identified.
